paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: : Loss steps
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the loss values over the number of iterations for several language models. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration", is a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 1440000, with tick labels spaced evenly at intervals of 10000. The y-axis, labeled “Loss”, is also linear and ranges from approximately 2.4 to 3.4, with tick marks spaced in increments of 0.2. A solid red line represents the Vanilla model, starting at a loss value of approximately 3.3 at iteration 0 and decreasing to a loss value of approximately 2.5 by iteration 1440000. A dashed orange line represents the StrmLLLM model which begins with a loss of approximately 3.2 at iteration 0 and reduces to a loss of approximately 2.7 by iteration 1440000. A solid blue line marks the SepLLM model with (n=64), starting at a loss of approximately 3.1 and decreasing to a loss of approximately 2.8 by iteration 1440000. A green line illustrates the SepLLM model with (n=64, H), beginning at a loss of approximately 3.0 and reaching a loss of approximately 2.6 by iteration 1440000. A dotted red line denotes the SepLLM model with (n=64, H/T), starting at a loss of approximately 2.9 and decreasing to a loss of approximately 2.6 by iteration 1440000. Finally, a solid blue line represents the SepLLM model with (n=128), starting at a loss of approximately 2.8 and decreasing to a loss of approximately 2.5 by iteration 1440000.
